name: OpenReview Round Comparison
description: Compare selected public review rounds and submission revisions in one OpenReview forum.

parameters.before_round: First pinned round identifier, for example round:1
parameters.after_round: Second pinned round identifier, for example round:2

questions: What concerns were recorded in ${before_round} of forum ${forum_id}?
Which responses and manuscript changes are visible by ${after_round}?
Which concerns remain unresolved, disputed, or unassessable?
success_criteria: Pin exact public note and manuscript document revisions
Separate author claims, machine correspondence, and independent human review
Cite before and after source revisions and state missing coverage
report_outline: Resolution states, disputes, limitations, and citations
